newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline recovers losses, U.S. arb closed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline recovers losses, U.S. arb closed.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices regained some strength on Tuesday but late gyrations in crude markets muddied the picture, traders said.
Eurograde barges changed hands at $204 fob ARA for storage material, then at $206 and $208. Offers and bids then evaporated as futures chopped and changed.
Swaps traders said markets finished the day almost unchanged from late Monday afternoon.
U.S. numbers were not considered attractive for most of the day and little cargo product is seen available in Europe.
